title: Vanili
description: A PVP texture pack for 1.8.9 that keeps vanilla feel but changes a few things.
body:
A lightweight PvP texture pack for Minecraft version 1.8.9 that is designed to improve and enhance the default (vanilla) look of the game.

![minecraft items in item frames with blocks beside it the item frames are on a oak plank wall.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca082b755fcf223a99f44bc9d4608add0a758b4a.png)

The texture pack retains the modern look and feel of Minecraft but has made some improvements to certain textures to enhance PvP gameplay.

### Features

* Clean and slightly edited vanilla-style textures
* Outlines for Wool, Concrete, Wood, and Endstone blocks
* Improved tools and weapons
* Designed for BedWars and PvP gameplay
* New texture for older versions

### Why use this texture pack?

The texture pack is a good option for anyone who wants a competitive advantage in their gameplay and still wants to stick with the default look and feel of Minecraft.
